**Verdict:** I do not think they are strong enough to keep the title. The best they can hope for is to stay in Division One. However, you should watch out for their many fast bowlers.

Burnley defender Michael Duff was happy with the 0-0 draw against Tottenham. He was pleased that his team stopped Harry Kane, a very good scorer, from scoring. This was Kane’s first game as Tottenham’s captain, but he did not lead his team to a win. The match was boring and ended without any goals.

The result did not help either team. If Burnley had won, they would have moved out of the bottom three positions in the league. However, because of this draw, Tottenham’s chances of finishing in the top four seem to be gone. Duff was specifically satisfied that his team kept Kane from scoring at Turf Moor on Sunday afternoon.

Sportsmail looks at 10 things we learned from the Premier League matches over the Easter weekend and the race for promotion in the Football League.

1. Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers made a big mistake by playing Jordan Henderson as a wing back instead of his usual central midfield position. The England star, who is now team captain because Steven Gerrard is absent, lost possession of the ball 23 times in 90 minutes while struggling with his new role against Arsenal. Henderson (left) had a hard game as a wing back in Liverpool's loss to Arsenal and gave the ball away 23 times.

Hull City wants to sign Nedum Onuoha, a defender for QPR. Onuoha might leave QPR if the team is relegated, as the club plans to reduce its size. He is 28 years old, has 15 months left on his contract, and plays regularly under coach Chris Ramsey. He started in the important 4-1 win against West Bromwich Albion on Saturday.

Hull City is not the only club interested in Onuoha. Everton, West Ham United, and Stoke City also want him. Mark Hughes, the manager of Stoke City, previously signed Onuoha for QPR. Meanwhile, QPR is talking about signing Nicolas Spolli, a defender from the Italian club Catania.

Harry Kane called it the "best week of my life" after captaining Tottenham and making his first start for England. At 21, he became the youngest Premier League captain this season and scored on his England debut. However, the week ended frustratingly for him because Tottenham failed to score in a 0-0 draw against Burnley. Burnley worked hard to earn a valuable point in their fight to avoid being relegated.

Benfica has asked about signing Diego de Girolamo from Sheffield United. The Italian forward is leaving Sheffield United this summer because his contract is ending. He has also received an offer from Juventus.

De Girolamo is currently on loan at Northampton. Several clubs are interested in him:

*   **Celtic** wants him to train with them before deciding whether to sign him.
*   **Southampton** is also interested.
*   **Juventus** has made an offer.
*   **Benfica** has made an inquiry.

De Girolamo is an Italy Under-20 international.

Bobby Zamora scored a beautiful goal by lifting the ball over West Brom’s goalkeeper, Boaz Myhill, from just outside the penalty area. This moment showed that even unlikely things can happen. It was likely the best goal of Zamora’s long career because it was so difficult and looked impossible just before the ball went into the net. Chris Ramsey, the manager, hopes QPR’s season can improve in a similarly surprising way. Many people thought QPR would fail, but this win—only their second away victory all season—brings them closer to avoiding relegation. Zamora, playing on the left, scored QPR’s third goal with an amazing shot from a tight angle at The Hawthorns.

Andy King believes his 50th goal for Leicester City might be the most important one he has ever scored. He scored it in the 86th minute of Saturday’s game. It was not a fancy goal. Jamie Vardy’s shot was weak, and King just tapped the ball into the net from six yards away, beating the West Ham goalkeeper, Adrian. However, this goal was enough to beat West Ham in a fast-paced match and give new hope to the team he has played for his entire career. King became the hero for Leicester City, who are struggling in the Premier League, by scoring late to secure a crucial win. He celebrated with his teammate David Nugent after scoring his 50th goal for the club.

West Bromwich Albion plans to pay £3 million this summer to sign Neil Taylor, a 26-year-old left-back from Wales. Swansea City is open to offers for him. Taylor has impressed several Premier League managers in recent years, including Brendan Rodgers at Liverpool and Alan Pardew at Crystal Palace. However, West Brom manager Tony Pulis wants to move quickly to secure the stylish defender, even though the club might have other busy plans for the summer.

Leicester manager Nigel Pearson said Esteban Cambiasso was the best player in Saturday’s 2-1 win against West Ham, even if he hadn’t scored. Cambiasso scored in the 12th minute to make it 1-0 at the King Power Stadium. He hit the ball cleanly from just outside the penalty area after it bounced to him. The 34-year-old, who used to play for Real Madrid, Inter Milan, and Argentina, received high praise from his manager.

Daniel Agger, a defender for Brondby and Denmark, has been suspended for two games for violent conduct. He was punished for elbowing Mattias Jorgensen in the head. This happened during a heated derby match against Copenhagen on Monday. The game ended in a 0-0 tie, and the referees did not take any action during the match. However, after reviewing video footage, the Danish Football Association’s disciplinary committee found Agger guilty.

James Tomkins wants to play for West Ham again before the season ends, but he knows his time might be up. Last month, he dislocated his shoulder while working out in the gym. He had successful surgery to fix it. Tomkins said, "Hopefully this won't slow me down too much, and I might get to play a few games before the season finishes. You never know." He also added, "It depends on how well the recovery goes."

Haris Vuckic is the only good result from a now-famous deal. While the other four players from the "Newcastle Five" have played only 44 minutes in total, Vuckic has done very well at Rangers. He says that staying at Rangers after this season would be a very attractive option. However, whether he can stay depends on several things. Vuckic denied a report claiming he has already decided to leave St James Park, where he has one year left on his contract. He will need to talk with his parent club this summer.

Harry Kane has scored many goals for Tottenham this season, so fans expect him to do well. However, he struggled during a crossbar challenge at an open training session at White Hart Lane on Thursday.

Kane tried to hit the crossbar from 40 yards away, but he missed. He was playing against other top Spurs players, including Etienne Capoue, Nabil Bentaleb, Eric Dier, Roberto Soldado, Danny Rose, and Christian Eriksen, who is known for being very good at this challenge. The phrase "Close but no cigar" describes Kane's first attempts, as he came near the bar but did not hit it.

Peter Lawwell, the chief executive of Celtic, recently said that Ronny Deila just needed to get past the "Le Guen hump." However, Lawwell could have mentioned other managers who failed closer to home. It is clear that Deila did not need to be an expert on Scottish football history to understand how serious the situation was earlier this season. By late autumn, Celtic had been eliminated from European competitions twice, and Hamilton Accies had beaten them at Celtic Park. There was no need to look far to find people who doubted Deila. The Celtic manager admitted that his first six months in charge were mentally difficult.

Real Madrid has appealed the yellow card given to Cristiano Ronaldo for diving during their 2-0 win over Rayo Vallecano. They hope to have his suspension canceled. Ronaldo was shown the card by referee Mario Melero Lopez after defender Antonio Amaya knocked him down inside the penalty area. Real Madrid believes this call was unfair. Because of the yellow card, Ronaldo will miss Saturday’s La Liga game against Eibar. He joins Toni Kroos and James Rodriguez, who are also suspended after receiving yellow cards.

Jeremy Peace, who owns 77% of West Bromwich Albion, wants to sell the club for between £150 million and £200 million. He has received interest from groups in America, China, and Australia, and some have already visited the club’s training facilities. However, Peace does not want a long, drawn-out sale process to disrupt the club’s plans for next season. If a deal is not finalized by July, he is prepared to cancel the sale and wait for a better opportunity in the future.

Rio Ferdinand says that Manchester United’s recent improvement is because Louis van Gaal moved Wayne Rooney back to his preferred position as a striker. In his column for The Sun, ahead of the match against Manchester City, Ferdinand—who now plays for Queens Park Rangers—explained that Rooney playing up front is key to the team performing at their best.

Ferdinand praised Van Gaal for moving Rooney higher up the field after he had played in the middle of the pitch earlier in the year. However, he also noted that the return to fitness and good form of Ander Herrera, Marouane Fellaini, and Michael Carrick has been important to the team’s success.

Manchester City will play Crystal Palace on Easter Monday. They are facing Glenn Murray, who is the most dangerous striker in the Premier League based on statistics. This season, Murray scores a goal every 91 minutes on average. This is a better record than any other player in the top league.

Harry Kane and Diego Costa each have 19 goals. They are tied for fourth and fifth place in the race for the top scorer title. They are behind Papiss Cisse and Olivier Giroud.

Murray recently scored a penalty against Stoke City. Harry Kane has scored 19 goals for Tottenham, which has been a great year for him.

Boxing is a sport where fighters often have big egos, and people frequently say, "If he was chocolate, he’d eat himself," to describe their arrogance. Peter Quillin’s nickname is "Kid Chocolate," so you might expect him to be very full of himself. However, he is not arrogant at all. Next weekend, he will fight Andy Lee from Limerick, and Quillin comes across as humble rather than boastful.

Atletico Madrid moved into third place in the La Liga standings, beating Valencia for a spot in the Champions League. They won 2-0 against the last-place team, Cordoba, thanks to their top scorer, Antoine Griezmann.

The win gave Atletico 62 points from 29 games, putting them ahead of Valencia, who have 60 points and are in fourth place. Valencia can take third place back if they beat sixth-place Villarreal on Sunday.

Griezmann scored the first goal in the fifth minute. He took the ball from the midfield, ran forward, and shot it into the bottom corner of the net. This was his 15th goal of the season.

Alan Pardew, the manager of Crystal Palace, says he is better than many famous managers in the Premier League. However, he does not plan to leave Crystal Palace for a team that is currently at the top of the league.

Since Pardew took over from Neil Warnock at the start of the year, Crystal Palace has won six out of ten league games. This success has almost guaranteed that the team will stay in the Premier League next season. When Pardew started, the team was in the bottom three, but their rise up the rankings has reduced fears of being relegated. This has also improved Pardew’s reputation, even though he has never managed a club that regularly competes for major trophies. Pardew believes he has the skills to manage one of England’s best teams.

Billy Joe Saunders and Chris Eubank Jr. might fight again in less than six weeks. They started arguing again at a press conference in London on Thursday.

The two boxers had a famous 12-round fight on November 29. In that match, Saunders, who holds the British, Commonwealth, and European middleweight titles, beat Eubank for the first time in his career.

Both men are scheduled to fight at Wembley Arena on May 9, but not against each other. Eubank will defend his WBA interim belt, while Saunders will have a practice fight. Saunders plans to challenge for the WBO middleweight title in July.

A headline in a matchday magazine was surprisingly accurate. On pages 16 and 17 of the United Review, next to a photo of Ander Herrera, it said, “Right place, right time.” However, this hasn’t always been true during his first season at Manchester United. Between October 20 and February 17, Herrera rarely played. He started only three of the 21 games the team played during that time, which led to many questions about his role on the squad.

On Saturday night, Manchester United beat Aston Villa 3-1. This win moved them into third place in the Premier League, putting them ahead of their rivals, Manchester City.

Ander Herrera scored the first goal before halftime. Wayne Rooney scored the second goal after halftime. Christian Benteke scored one goal for Aston Villa, managed by Tim Sherwood. However, Herrera scored his second goal late in the game to make the final score 3-1. This secured the win for Manchester United.

Sportsmail’s Dominic King gave player ratings for the match at Old Trafford. Manchester United played in a 4-3-3 formation.

Joey Barton says QPR should use their win against West Brom to help them stay in the league. QPR won 4-1 against West Brom, who had only 10 players because one was sent off. This win ended a streak of five losses for QPR and gave them only their second away win of the season.

QPR is still in the bottom three of the Premier League, but they are only three points behind Aston Villa, who are also fighting to stay in the league. QPR has a better goal difference than Aston Villa, and they will play Aston Villa on Tuesday.

Joey Barton, who plays for QPR and scored in this game, thinks his team has a very good chance of staying in the league. He also captained the team to this

Anthony Joshua beat American Jason Gavern in the third round on Saturday night, but he was not happy with how he fought. Gavern, who was in his 50th fight, was knocked down four times—twice in the second round and twice in the third—before the referee stopped the match in Newcastle. Joshua, who had been out of boxing for five months because of a stress fracture in his back, admitted he did not perform at his best.

Rangers manager Stuart McCall strongly criticized player David Templeton. Templeton, a former Hearts player, had said that McCall’s training methods were much better than those used by the previous managers, Ally McCoist and Kenny McDowall.

McCall was not happy with these comments. He suggested that Templeton might have made them because he didn’t play enough games under the old managers. This happened while McCall was busy improving the team, which has now won three games in a row in the Championship.

Dereck Chisora plans to return to boxing this summer, and he wants to fight his British rival, David Price. Chisora, known as "Del Boy," has not fought since November, when Tyson Fury stopped him at the ExCeL Arena in London. That match was a final test to see who would get a chance to fight Wladimir Klitschko for the WBO heavyweight title. Now, Fury is the required challenger for that belt. Meanwhile, Chisora has been resting and healing from an eye injury he suffered during the ten-round fight.

Dave King is now very close to becoming the chairman of Rangers. The Court of Session has allowed him to return as a director of the club. The businessman, who lives in South Africa, hopes this decision will help the Scottish Football Association (SFA) approve him as "fit and proper" in the final step. Last month, 85 percent of the shareholders voted for him to join the Rangers board. However, he has not taken the job yet because he is waiting to clear all regulatory rules. Now that the court has cleared him, he is back on the Rangers board.

Manchester United manager Louis van Gaal has told his players that they have not yet guaranteed a spot in the Champions League. Even though they now have an eight-point lead over Liverpool, Van Gaal wants to stay focused.

After beating Aston Villa 3-1, he sees next Sunday’s match against Manchester City as very important for finishing in second place. When Van Gaal took over from David Moyes last summer, his job was to get the team into the top four. He is making sure his players do not become too comfortable, even though Liverpool’s 4-1 loss to Arsenal on Saturday has put United in a strong position.

Barcelona manager Luis Enrique says that midfielder Xavi will be very important for the team in the final months of the season. The club is trying to win three major trophies, just as they did in 2009.

Xavi is 35 years old. He recently went to Qatar to talk about joining the team Al Sadd next season. This year, he has started only five games out of 21. However, after Xavi helped score the winning goal against Celta Vigo on Sunday, Enrique believes Xavi still has a key role to play in Barcelona’s effort to win the treble.

Celta Vigo player Fabian Orellana has been banned from playing for one game by the Spanish football federation. The club confirmed this on their website after Orellana was shown a red card for throwing grass at Barcelona player Sergio Busquets.

This happened during Barcelona’s 1-0 win on Sunday. Orellana got angry because he thought Busquets was wasting time, so he picked up a piece of turf and threw it at him. Busquets pretended to be hurt by the grass, holding his eye even though the grass actually hit him in the back of the neck.

Sven Bender told his Borussia Dortmund teammates that they must start scoring more goals if they want to forget about their bad season. The team, managed by Jurgen Klopp, has failed to score in four of their last five league games. Because of this, it is becoming very hard for them to finish in the top spots that qualify for the Champions League. They are currently in 10th place and unlikely to reach Europe. Bender admitted that the team needs to start scoring as soon as possible, especially with their upcoming DFB Pokal match against Hoffenheim on Tuesday.

Franck Ribery says he refused to join Real Madrid five years ago because Bayern Munich told him he was just as important to them as Lionel Messi is to Barcelona. The 32-year-old French player has won four Bundesliga titles and one Champions League with Bayern. However, things might have been different if his move to Real Madrid in 2009 had happened. Real Madrid wanted Ribery after he had a disagreement with Bayern’s coach, Louis van Gaal. But the club’s leaders convinced him to stay by emphasizing how crucial he was to the team.

Former Italy striker Antonio Di Natale says Alexis Sanchez is the best player he has ever played with. He also believes Sanchez is better than Neymar.

Di Natale played with Sanchez for five years at Udinese. He still captains that team at age 37. He won 42 games for Italy between 2002 and 2012. He has also played with famous players like Francesco Totti and Alessandro Del Piero. However, Di Natale told Arsenal’s official website that Sanchez is the best of them all.

Roma has been ordered to close part of their stadium for their next home game because fans were punished for displaying an offensive banner last weekend. The banner was shown during Roma’s 1-0 win over Napoli on Saturday. It caused anger because it insulted the mother of a Napoli fan who died in violent clashes between fans last year. A league disciplinary panel said the banner was intentionally insulting to the mother of an opposing fan who died in dramatic circumstances. Although Roma players celebrated their victory, the club has been penalized for the banner.

Alan Stubbs, the manager of Hibernian, is one of the main candidates to become the new manager of Wigan Athletic. This news came after Wigan fired their current manager, Malky Mackay, on Monday.

Stubbs is currently leading his team, Hibernian, in a difficult fight to get promoted. However, he is also a top choice for Wigan, who are struggling to stay in the Championship league and are currently second from the bottom.

Another reason Stubbs is a strong candidate is that his assistant, John Doolan, previously worked with Wigan’s former manager, Uwe Rosler. Rosler was fired in November.

Juventus kept their hopes of winning three major trophies alive by winning the second leg of their match, even though they lost the first one. They won thanks to goals from Alessandro Matri, Roberto Pereyra, and Leonardo Bonucci. This victory was especially impressive because the team was missing three important players: Carlos Tevez, Paul Pogba, and Andrea Pirlo. Just hours before the game started, they learned that Tevez could not play because of a thigh injury. However, his absence did not hurt the team’s chances. Leonardo Bonucci scored the third goal for his team and was celebrated by his teammates after helping Juventus advance to the final.

Several football clubs, including Norwich, Leicester, Newcastle, and Stoke, are interested in signing Kevin Toner, a young defender for Aston Villa. Toner is only 18 years old but already captains the club’s Under-21 team and is considered one of their most promising young players.

His current contract ends this summer. Aston Villa wants to keep him and has offered him a new deal. However, other clubs are ready to make official offers, so Villa might lose him.

Ronny Deila praised his players for winning at St Mirren, which extended Celtic’s lead at the top of the league. James Forrest scored one goal, and Stefan Johansen scored a penalty. These goals were enough to beat St Mirren, who played well, and put Celtic eight points ahead of Aberdeen.

Deila was happy with how his team stayed calm and won the game. However, he criticized the condition of the pitch in Paisley, saying it made things harder for his team. He also warned that Scottish football will have trouble producing top players unless the quality of pitches improves significantly.

Celtic midfielder Stefan Johansen says the team’s chances of winning the title "look great" after they beat St Mirren 2-0 on Friday night. James Forrest scored the first goal from close range, and Johansen added the second by scoring a penalty in the 79th minute. The win puts Celtic eight points ahead of Aberdeen at the top of the Scottish Premiership. Both teams have played 29 games, but Aberdeen can close the gap by playing Partick Thistle on Saturday.

Gary Player is going to his 58th Masters tournament this week. He expects a new member to join the sport’s most exclusive group and wants to honor what he believes is one of the best achievements in golf history. Player thinks Tiger Woods did the best job when he completed the career Grand Slam at just 24 years old. Therefore, he is very excited about the possibility of Rory McIlroy becoming only the sixth player to win all four major championships at age 25. The South African legend said, “I don’t think people fully understand how amazing that would be.” When Player completed his own Grand Slam at age 29, he told his wife that he didn’t think anyone would ever do it again.

Gene Sarazen, Ben Hogan, and Tiger Woods all completed their career Grand Slams at famous, important golf events. Now, Rory McIlroy has the chance to join these five great players by winning the Masters at Augusta National. Tiger Woods said there is no better place to finish a career Grand Slam than here. McIlroy played a practice round before the 2015 Masters. He is trying to win his third major title and complete his career Grand Slam.

They will play against each other in the first major tournament of the year on Thursday. Not long ago, Rory McIlroy looked up to Tiger Woods. McIlroy is now the world number one, ranking 103 places higher than Woods. He is the favorite to win the Masters next week and get his first green jacket. If he wins, he will complete a career Grand Slam. Woods has said he is ready to play at Augusta after working on his game. He is one of only five players to win the Masters, The Open, the US PGA Championship, and the US Open. This success is why a young McIlroy wanted to be like him.

Barcelona’s coach, Luis Enrique, is not worried that Neymar has not scored recently. He believes the Brazilian player will soon get back to his best as the team tries to repeat their historic success from 2009. Neymar had a strong first half of the season, but since January, he has not scored in La Liga. His last goal was on February 15, when Barcelona beat Levante 5-0. The 23-year-old seemed out of sorts in Sunday’s 1-0 win against Celta Vigo. During that game, he spent a lot of time arguing with Celta’s fullback, Hugo Mallo.

Ian Poulter spent a week in the Bahamas relaxing in the sun, drinking champagne, and watching yachts in the marina. This might not seem like how a golfer prepares to win the Masters, but Poulter says this break makes him feel fit and ready for the tournament at Augusta National. The time off gave him a chance to imagine winning the green jacket and deciding what he would eat at the champion’s dinner next year. He does not need to think hard about the dinner menu.

Manuel Pellegrini said he is not worried about losing his job as Manchester City’s manager, even though their chances of winning the title were hurt by a loss to Crystal Palace. Crystal Palace won the game thanks to goals from Glenn Murray and Jason Puncheon. This result puts City in fourth place, nine points behind the league leaders, Chelsea, and makes it harder for them to qualify for next season’s Champions League. City scored a late goal through Sergio Aguero, but they were angry that Murray’s first goal was allowed to count. They believed it should have been ruled offside, and many City players surrounded the referee, Michael Oliver, to complain.

Former Manchester United player Quinton Fortune says Neymar did not look like his usual self during Barcelona’s narrow 1-0 win over Celta Vigo. The victory kept Barcelona four points ahead of their title rivals, Real Madrid. However, Fortune believes Barcelona’s coach, Luis Enrique, should be worried about Neymar’s body language. Fortune says Neymar looked uncomfortable during the match. Neymar, who plays alongside Lionel Messi, did not play well against Celta Vigo.

Charlie Adam, a midfielder for Stoke City, scored one of the best goals in Premier League history, even though his team lost to Chelsea. The 29-year-old Scottish player picked up the ball in his own half and kicked it 66 yards toward the goal. Chelsea’s goalkeeper, Thibaut Courtois, tried to stop the shot but failed. Adam, who used to play for Liverpool, called it the best goal of his career.

Chelsea captain John Terry said Eden Hazard is one of the best players in the world after Hazard helped Chelsea beat Stoke 2-1. Hazard scored a penalty to put Chelsea ahead. Then, Charlie Adam scored a famous 66-yard goal to tie the game for Stoke. But Loic Remy scored the winning goal after receiving a pass from Hazard. This win put Chelsea seven points ahead at the top of the Premier League. Terry praised Hazard again after the game. Hazard, who plays for Belgium, scored the first goal and did not miss when facing the goalkeeper, Asmir Begovic.

Raheem Sterling first became famous worldwide in a TV documentary about Brendan Rodgers’ early time as Liverpool’s manager in the summer of 2012. The video showed Rodgers scolding Sterling, then a talented but inexperienced teenager, for talking back to him.

More than two and a half years later, things have changed a lot. Sterling is now a 20-year-old player for the England national team and a key member of Liverpool’s starting lineup.

On Wednesday, he was back on TV, but this time he was in control. Sterling has refused to sign a new contract with Liverpool and has delayed contract discussions until the summer.

Derby County suffered a major setback. They were close to winning their first game in seven Championship matches against Watford, who had only 10 players on the field. However, they conceded an equalizing goal from Odion Ighalo, which hurts their chances of moving up to a higher league.

With 15 minutes left, Adlene Guedioura took advantage of weak defending by Craig Forsyth. He made a precise pass to Ighalo, who scored past goalkeeper Lee Grant to secure a surprising tie for Watford.

Derby County fought back hard in the final minutes, spending most of the time attacking inside Watford’s penalty area. In the last moment of the game, Watford’s goalkeeper, Heurelho Gomes, made a crucial save with his

Just 12 weeks ago, Dundee United players were very confident that they could win three major trophies this season. Goalkeeper Radoslaw Cierzniak said, “I believe we can win all three trophies. People might laugh at me, but maybe in May we will have won the league and cups, and I will be laughing.”

However, on Wednesday night, when Dundee United played against Dundee at Dens Park, those early January hopes seemed far away. Cierzniak made a mistake that led to Greg Stewart’s first goal, showing that he had lost touch with reality. Now, Dundee United’s manager, Jackie McNamara, is facing pressure because his team has been playing poorly lately.

Tottenham Hotspur wants to sign Andre Ayew, a forward who plays for Marseille. His current contract ends this summer, so he can move to a new team for free. Tottenham’s representatives have told Ayew’s team that they are interested. However, many top European clubs also want to sign him, making the competition very tough. Inter Milan is currently the favorite to sign Ayew.

Paris Saint-Germain player Edinson Cavani has denied rumors that he does not get along with his teammate Zlatan Ibrahimovic. He says the only problem is that he is sometimes played in a position that doesn’t suit him.

Some reports had suggested that the two players had a falling out. Earlier in the season, coach Laurent Blanc even said that they needed to work better together on the field.

Cavani, who used to play for Napoli, admits that he and Ibrahimovic are not necessarily friends. However, he dismissed the idea that there is a serious conflict between them.

The news comes after Cavani was seen arguing with a referee during PSG’s 3-2 win against Marseilles at the New Stade Velodrome.

Nick Abendanon was the only happy Englishman at the Stade Marcel Michelin on Saturday night. He led Northampton on a chase, and after the game, he showed that he still has faint hopes of playing in the World Cup.

Abendanon, who used to play for Bath and now plays for Clermont Auvergne, played very well as the Premiership champions lost badly, 37-5. He scored one try from far away and helped score two others. Because of this, he was named the best player of the match.

Abendanon last played for England in 2007. However, coaches still kept him in mind until he moved to France last summer. After his excellent performance, he said he has not given up on the small chance of being called

Paul Casey really wants to play in the Ryder Cup again, even though it seems unlikely he will rejoin the European Tour in time to earn the points needed to qualify. Only members of the European Tour can play on the team. Casey, who lives in Phoenix, gave up his membership in January so he could focus on the PGA Tour and try to get back into the world’s top 50 players. This plan has worked. The former world number 3 lost a playoff in the Northern Trust Open and tied for third place in the Honda Classic, which moved him up to number 44 in the world rankings at the start of this week. As he practices for the Masters in Augusta, Casey says he desperately wants to return to the Ryder Cup.

Harry Redknapp, the former manager of QPR, says that Raheem Sterling has the upper hand in his contract dispute with Liverpool. However, Redknapp believes Sterling should focus on playing football instead of worrying about his salary. He argues that Sterling is not yet ready to join big clubs like Real Madrid and should stay at Liverpool, where he has grown as a player. At the same time, Redknapp admits that if Sterling really wants to leave, Liverpool cannot stop him. Sterling has already rejected a new contract with the club and delayed discussions until the summer.

Mauricio Pochettino may have stopped believing that Tottenham can qualify for the Champions League, but Harry Kane disagrees. The 21-year-old, who became the youngest Premier League captain this season during a scoreless draw against Burnley on Easter Sunday, still thinks they can finish in the top four.

Tottenham is currently seven points behind Manchester City, who play Crystal Palace on Monday night. There are only seven games left in the season. Although it is a difficult task, Kane believes they still have a chance. He recently called his last few days "the best week of my life" and remains confident they can make it.

For many afternoons, after the players left Tottenham’s training center, Tim Sherwood would spend hours in the staff cafeteria with his coaches, Chris Ramsey and Les Ferdinand. The three men were always together. They formed a close team after Tottenham chairman Daniel Levy put Sherwood in charge of the club’s youth and Under-21 programs in 2008.

On Tuesday evening, Sherwood, Ramsey, and Ferdinand will be on opposite sides at Villa Park. They will each try to lead their teams away from the risk of being relegated (dropped to a lower league) during the final, stressful weeks of the Barclays Premier League season. The photo shows Tim Sherwood, Les Ferdinand, and Chris Ramsey together during their time at White Hart Lane.

Raheem Sterling’s manager, Brendan Rodgers, says that Sterling has never told him he wants to leave Liverpool. Rodgers insists that their relationship is strong and that Sterling is focused on playing football.

Even though Sterling gave an interview last week suggesting he might be thinking about his future at the club, and he has not yet signed a new contract, Rodgers is not worried. He believes Sterling will stay and play for the rest of the season.

Chelsea manager Jose Mourinho has made Raheem Sterling’s contract dispute with Liverpool more serious by saying he would sell any player who wants to leave. Sterling’s future at Liverpool is now uncertain because he gave a TV interview on Wednesday explaining why he paused talks about a new contract. As reported by Sportsmail on Thursday, Chelsea wants to sign the 20-year-old and has asked to be kept informed about his situation. Arsenal is also interested in signing the England international. Raheem Sterling, pictured training on Thursday, has turned down a new deal with Liverpool worth £100,000 a week.

Michael Owen has warned Raheem Sterling that life after Liverpool might not be as good as he expects. This comes after the young England player said he turned down a £100,000-a-week contract at Liverpool.

Owen also started his career at Liverpool but moved to Real Madrid in 2004. However, he believes Sterling is not good enough to make that same move to Spain.

Chelsea, Arsenal, and Manchester City are all interested in signing Sterling, who is currently one of the most sought-after players in English football. But Liverpool is determined to keep him, even though his contract ends at the end of next season.

Some tour guides will do anything to get a good tip. In the Australian outback, if you want to get close to a group of local emus, you need a guide who is willing to get dirty. A video posted online by a YouTube user named Ratbag Nomad shows how this is done. The video features a man called Australianwidefishingguide showing tourists how to attract the birds. Emus are well-known flightless birds in Australia that are very curious. As the guide slowly kicked his legs in the air, the group of emus started coming closer and closer. The video, which was filmed from a vehicle on an empty dirt road in the bush, shows the guide lying on his back and kicking his legs to lure a group of emus from a distance.

Olivier Giroud and Arsene Wenger from Arsenal have been named the Barclays Premier League Player and Manager of the Month for March. Giroud, a striker from France, won the award instead of Harry Kane, who was trying to win it for the third time in a row.

Giroud scored five goals in four league games for Arsenal last month. This helped his team win all four games and earn all 12 possible points. Because of this, Arsenal is now just one point behind second-place Manchester City, with eight games left to play.

No footballer has ever been late for a game because he was busy negotiating a new contract. Therefore, Raheem Sterling’s reason for ending talks with Liverpool does not make sense. The problem is not the negotiations themselves, but his mindset. No player sits in an office arguing over image rights and then rushes out the door just before kickoff. A player might feel unsure about his future and worry about where he will play next season—whether at Liverpool, Arsenal, or another country. However, waiting until the end of the season to decide does not fix this worry. In fact, it makes the problem worse.

Jaap Stam had just ordered a new kitchen for his home in Cheshire when Manchester United manager Sir Alex Ferguson told him he was being sold to Lazio. Ferguson did not mention in that conversation that his son, Jason, would earn a seven-figure sum as an agent for the deal. Stam’s representatives found out about this money later.

In other news, Raheem Sterling shook hands with Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers during training on Thursday. They were at Melwood with the rest of the Liverpool team, getting ready to play Arsenal. Rodgers is confident that Sterling will stay with the club and that the situation will be resolved in the summer.

Dove’s new ad, called "One Beautiful Thought," shows what happens when women’s own harsh criticisms of their bodies are spoken aloud. Dove, which usually promotes positive messages about real women, decided to test this idea. They asked a group of women to write down every negative thing they thought about themselves in a notebook. Then, the women gave those notebooks back to Dove.

Two 18-month-old twin boys died after accidentally falling into a canal in Yuma, Arizona, on Friday morning at 9:45 a.m. Police searched for more than an hour before pulling them from the water. A U.S. Marine Corps helicopter flew them to a local hospital, where doctors pronounced them dead. Police officer Franklin said investigators believe the accident was just that—an accident—and do not suspect any crime.

Paul Sturrock had a very difficult start as the manager of Yeovil. In his very first game, just two days after he was hired, the team was relegated for the second year in a row.

Before taking the job at Yeovil, Sturrock, who is 58 years old, had worked as an advisor for another team, Torquay, for four days. He had previously been promoted five times as a manager. However, Yeovil’s 1-1 tie with Notts County meant they were sent down to a lower league. This happened at Yeovil’s home stadium, Huish Park. So, Sturrock experienced relegation with the club on only his second day in charge.

Former US President George H.W. Bush looked healthy on Friday when he went to the U.S. Men's Clay Court Championship in Houston, Texas, with Australian tennis player Roy Emerson. The 90-year-old had been sick in December and was in the hospital because he had trouble breathing. But this time, he was smiling and enjoying the fresh air, and he seemed happier. Bush likes ATP World Tour 250 tennis events. He and his wife, Barbara, live in the Houston area. Over the years, they have gone to many tennis fundraisers and charity events together.

Mark O'Meara had one of the best rounds of the day, which helped him qualify for the weekend at the Masters. This was his first time making the cut in 10 years. The 1998 champion started the tournament one stroke over par, but he shot a 68 in his second round. He made five birdies, including three in just four holes on the front nine. At 58 years old, O'Meara is the third-oldest player in the 2015 field, behind Tom Watson (65) and Ben Crenshaw (63). His performance was excellent, marking his first round in the 60s at Augusta since 2001. By shooting a 68 on day two

Manchester City has apologized to fans and promised to refund ticket costs because their free buses were late and missed the start of the game against Crystal Palace. The Premier League champions wrote to 300 fans who used the free transport for the match at Selhurst Park. The club provided the buses because the game was scheduled for 8 pm, which made it impossible for fans to take the train, and the area is already hard to reach. Meanwhile, Edin Dzeko and his teammates discussed their loss at Crystal Palace.

Advertising businessman John Singleton is selling his beautiful beach house on the central coast of New South Wales. The house is next to the Killcare Surf Life Saving Club and has five bedrooms with great views of the Pacific Ocean.

Singleton bought the house at 80 Beach Drive in late 2007 for $4.25 million, which was a record price for the area. Agents say the auction on May 9 will start with bids at $3.5 million, according to Property Observer.

The house has large open living spaces that lead to a covered front balcony.

Cricket is played all over the world, as shown by these photos of children, amateur players, and professional stars. These pictures are the finalists for the 2014 Wisden–MCC Cricket Photograph of the Year. The winner was Matthew Lewis, a photographer for Getty Images. His photo shows Dwayne Bravo making an amazing full-length catch for the West Indies to get James Faulkner out during the ICC World Twenty20 tournament in Bangladesh last year. The list also includes photos of regular players, such as children playing on a garbage dump in Bangladesh and a club player trying to catch the ball in Kent.

Robbie Fowler is one of the best strikers in Premier League history. Only five players have scored more goals than his 162. He played for Liverpool, Leeds, and Manchester City. He started playing for Liverpool in 1993 and became famous for scoring many goals. He also played 26 times for the England national team.

Fowler picked his favorite starting team of players from his time in football. One Dutch striker on his list is a bit unclear. Here is his goalkeeper choice: Peter Schmeichel.

A group of illegal dumpers threw 40 tonnes of industrial waste by the side of the road in a beautiful village in Suffolk. The police officer said this was the worst case he had seen in nearly 30 years. Cleaning up the trash will cost taxpayers thousands of pounds. Police believe the group used three tractors and trailers to bring the waste to Walsham-le-Willows, which is located between Eye and Bury St Edmunds.

Cody, a horse, fell into thick mud after wandering off during the Grand National excitement. He got stuck in a bog in Belvedere, south-east London, not at the famous Becher's Brook fence at Aintree. On Friday afternoon, rescue workers climbed into the muddy ditch to help him. It took them more than an hour to save Cody. He was covered in mud from head to hoof, but he was otherwise unharmed, even though he was shaken by the experience.

Council leaders in Stratford-upon-Avon were embarrassed because a leaflet about recycling could not be recycled itself. The leaflet, which was attached to green bins, told residents what items they could put in the bins. However, a small note at the bottom said, "This is not recyclable."

Earlier this year, the *Stratford Observer* reported that people in the Stratford district were among the best recyclers in England. Official government figures also showed that the Stratford District Council was in the top ten for recycling and composting for the second year in a row.

After Perth Glory lost 3-0 to Sydney FC, fans set off flares, and the club’s supporters may now face a five-year ban. Two teenagers have been charged because the flares caused a 13-year-old boy to burn his leg around 7:10 pm on Friday at nib Stadium in Perth.

The 16-year-old boy from Bicton is charged with causing grievous bodily harm and using signals and flares. He will appear in Perth Children’s Court on May 6. The 15-year-old boy from Palmyra is charged with causing grievous bodily harm and will appear in court on May 8.

Roberto Martinez has announced that Darron Gibson will miss the rest of the season. Gibson recently had tests on his injured foot bone (metatarsal). He was hurt during Everton’s 2-1 win over Queens Park Rangers last month.

At first, Martinez hoped Gibson could still play in the final seven games of the season. However, he now admits that this plan is no longer possible. This is bad news for the Everton manager, whose team has been playing better in recent weeks.

Despite this setback, there is some good news: Gibson does not need surgery. This is positive because Gibson missed almost all of Martinez’s first season with a serious knee injury (cruciate ligament damage).

The body of Brian Gewirtz, a 20-year-old autistic man, was found floating in a creek near a golf course. He had been missing for 44 days.

Brian was an Eagle Scout. On February 17, he told his family in Brooklyn, New York, that he was going for a walk near his home, but he never came back. His family searched frantically and warned people that Brian has autism, which made it difficult for him to understand spoken language.

Police said on Friday that they found his body at Marine Park Golf Club, which is about two miles from his home.

Abdul Hadi Arwani, a 48-year-old imam, was found dead in his Volkswagen Passat in Wembley on Wednesday morning. He had been shot in the chest. Police believe his murder may be linked to terrorism.

Arwani had recently been replaced as the leader of the An-Noor mosque in Acton. His replacement is Hassan Anyabwile, a preacher from Trinidad and Tobago. Anyabwile was involved in an attempted coup d'état 25 years ago. Arwani had been in a dispute with his former workplace, the mosque, before he was replaced. People described Arwani as a very peaceful man.

Everton plans to extend Darron Gibson’s contract this summer while he recovers from his latest injury. Manager Roberto Martinez said on Thursday that Gibson will miss the last seven games of the season because of an injury to his foot. However, he does not need surgery and should be ready for pre-season training.

Gibson has had a difficult time over the past 18 months, including a serious knee injury where he tore his cruciate ligaments. Because of this, his position at the club is uncertain. This is especially true because Everton may try to sign Tom Cleverley again in the summer, as they have been interested in him for a long time.

Bradley Neil didn’t want his role at the Masters. He was the caddie for Jordan Spieth, whose great opening round made Neil’s own performance look bad. While Spieth played well on the famous golf course, Neil struggled.

Neil got to play in the Masters because he won the Scottish Boys Championship in 2013 and the British Amateur Championship last year. In his first Masters, he finished 13 strokes over par.

Neil is still an amateur, but he is only 19 years old. World number one Rory McIlroy says Neil will be a huge star when he turns professional.

On Thursday at the Masters, Danny Willett shouted loudly at a rules official who was watching him. The official was sitting in a golf cart about 60 yards away, outside the ropes that separate spectators from the players. His words were clearly heard by the fans around the 17th green.

Willett was angry because his second shot from beyond the green rolled all the way across the putting surface. This mistake left him facing a bogey or worse. He yelled at the official, saying, "Of anyone you should know the rules."

Bradley Neil admitted he needed to push himself harder after failing to make the cut in his first Masters tournament at Augusta National. The 19-year-old golfer from Scotland scored 78 and 79, finishing 13 strokes over par. However, he ended his round well by making a birdie on the 18th hole. Neil, who won the 2014 Amateur Championship, said the experience was difficult but very educational. He played alongside 1988 Masters winner Sandy Lyle and noted that playing against the world’s best players taught him a lot. He stated that he wants to be competing at this level in a few years and plans to keep working hard.

Forget about fetching sticks. This dog who loves music prefers to play piano sonatas. Sadie, a German Shepherd, was filmed at her home in Alberta, Canada. She used her nose to turn on an electric organ and sat down to play. The video shows her placing her front paws on the keyboard while sitting with her back legs on the piano stool. Instead of playing classical music, Sadie seems to play a simple piece with clashing notes and no steady beat. After starting confidently, the puppy pauses and looks at the camera. Her owner, who is filming, asks, "Oh, did you make a mistake?"

Police are angry with drivers who played an impromptu game of football on the M25 motorway in Kent. The game happened because traffic was stopped for about an hour.

The road between Junction 4 and Junction 5 in Orpington was closed so an air ambulance could land. It was there to help a woman who was seriously injured in a motorcycle accident.

While people were stuck in the long traffic jam, some drivers started kicking a ball around on the closed road. Kent Police reported this behavior.

Rory McIlroy still has a lot of work to do to win the famous green jacket, but he must be patient if he wants to complete a career grand slam at Augusta. The world’s number one player started slowly but finished with a score of 71, which was one stroke under par. However, he finished seven shots behind the first-round leader, Jordan Spieth.

McIlroy needs the players who go out early on Friday to make mistakes so he can catch up. He is scheduled to play in the second-to-last group with Phil Mickelson and Ryan Moore at 6:48 pm (BST).

Toto Wolff, the head of Mercedes Motorsport, does not think the team should beg the German government for more money to compete with Ferrari. Recently, Ferrari returned to the top of the podium in Malaysia for the first time in nearly two years. This result pushed reigning champion Lewis Hamilton and his teammate Nico Rosberg to second and third place.

It seems like a busy way to start the week before your wedding, but Andy Murray is handling a work matter before he relaxes and prepares for his big day. He is playing in the final of the Miami Open against Novak Djokovic.

Murray is getting married to Kim Sears in Dunblane on Saturday. Whether he wins or loses the tennis match on Sunday, he will go straight to the airport to return home and focus on the wedding next weekend.

Murray reached the final by beating Tomas Berdych in the semi-finals. His fiancée, Kim Sears, watched him play in the hot weather in Miami.

Glasgow Warriors are on high alert because they might have to sell Richie Gray. If Castres, his current club, is relegated from the Top 14 league, Gray will be sold to the highest bidder. Francis Coquelin is eager to make the most of his time at Arsenal and says he wants to follow the example of club legend Patrick Vieira. Since returning from a loan spell at Charlton earlier this season, Coquelin has done well in the center of Arsenal’s midfield and has been praised for his strong play. Vieira was the team captain during the early, successful years of Arsene Wenger’s time at the club, and Coquelin hopes he can keep playing well enough to be like him. Coquelin, who has become a key part of the midfield, is shown celebrating with fans.

Last week, news stories focused on police racial profiling after an unarmed black father of four was fatally shot during a routine traffic stop in South Carolina. However, a young black man named Will Stack has released a video challenging the idea that all white police officers judge people based on their skin color. Stack, a 22-year-old U.S. Army National Guardsman, says there are "good cops out there." His video, which has become very popular on social media, shares his personal experience with a white police officer in Lexington County, South Carolina.

Surveillance video has shown the moment two Idaho police officers fatally shot a pregnant woman. Jeanetta Riley, 35, was a mother of three daughters. She was killed last July after she held a knife up to two officers outside a hospital in Sandpoint on the evening of July 8, 2014. According to the Guardian, Riley, who struggled with meth and alcohol addiction, had been taken to the hospital by her 44-year-old husband, Shane, because she had threatened to kill herself.

Police in Tulare, California, say that 41-year-old Georgina Rojas-Medina was shot and killed by her husband, 44-year-old Gerardo Tovar. After killing her, Tovar shot himself.

Neighbors were called to the scene by the couple’s 4-year-old daughter just after midnight on Saturday. The child had to walk past her dead mother and father to get help. Bloody footprints show the path she took after finding them.

Researchers say that children who share iPads in class do better on early reading tests than those who do not. This finding comes after the head of the National Association of Head Teachers said he was unsure about using technology in subjects other than computer classes. However, studies show that sharing devices leads to the best results for children’s reading skills.

Dr. Seuss was a very creative writer known for his funny rhymes and strange drawings. Now, one of his stories seems to have come true in Alaska, 130 miles from Anchorage.

This huge building was originally a two-story house. It was built after a forest fire burned down all the trees in the valley. Today, fans of Dr. Seuss travel to Alaska to see this structure, which is 12 cabins high and looks like one of his illustrations.

The owner built it so high that they could see the beautiful valley over the tall trees. The house was left empty for many years, but new owners are now fixing it up.

On Sunday, during the first IndyCar Grand Prix of Louisiana, a pit crew member named Todd Phillips was hit by a race car. Phillips worked as a front-outside tire changer for Dayle Coyne Racing.

The accident happened on Lap 25 when driver Francesco Dracone pulled into the pit box to get new tires and fuel. As Dracone was leaving the pit box, he lost control of his car, spun around, and hit Phillips’ leg.

Phillips was taken to the infield care center for treatment. He received stitches for a cut on his leg and was then released.

A sports plane crashed onto a highway in north-west Germany on Sunday afternoon, killing one man. The four-seater plane went down near Hatten, in the Oldenburg area, shortly after taking off from a nearby airfield.

According to local police, the pilot died in the crash. Three passengers were taken to a nearby hospital. Emergency services say one of the passengers, who was likely the co-pilot of the Cessna 172 plane, is in serious condition.

Manchester City captain Vincent Kompany says that UEFA’s Financial Fair Play (FFP) rules protect big, established clubs instead of helping smaller teams avoid bankruptcy. Last year, Manchester City was found to have broken these rules. As a result, they were fined £50 million and allowed to spend only £49 million on new players this season.

Kompany argues that FFP keeps the current power structure in place. He points out that Manchester City has no debt because its owner, Sheikh Mansour, has invested a lot of his own money. In contrast, Manchester United spent £150 million on new players last summer, even though the club owes about £400 million.

John Axford, a pitcher for the Colorado Rockies, is taking time off from baseball to care for his young son. Last month, his son was bitten by a rattlesnake in Arizona.

Axford was placed on the family medical emergency list before the Rockies’ game on Sunday. His son had surgery last Monday, which was Opening Day for the Rockies, to remove dead tissue from his right foot. He was bitten twice and still needs more treatment.

Axford celebrated his birthday on April 1 with cake and his two sons, JB and Jameson.

Egyptian officials left an African football event early because they were upset by a belly dancing performance. Dina Talaat performed a spectacular show at the opening ceremony of the Confederation of African Football’s (CAF) Ordinary General Assembly in Cairo. However, delegates from Egypt, including Khaled Abdel Aziz, the Egyptian Minister of Youth and Sports, stayed in a separate room inside the hotel until the performance ended, it was claimed. Manchester United beat Manchester City 4-2 at Old Trafford, which led to many funny pictures spreading on Twitter. Sergio Aguero scored first for City, but Ashley Young, Marouane Fellaini, Juan Mata, and Chris Smalling scored for United. Aguero scored a second goal, but it was too late to save City’s chances of winning the Premier League.

The big win inspired Twitter users to make viral jokes about City. Some pictures called David Moyes a "football genius" for signing Juan Mata and Marouane Fellaini. Another joke used a scene from the Austin Powers movies to mock City’s sudden drop in performance.

A study of hidden camera footage from a London pub shows that modern men talk about their families and personal lives more than about sports or women. Over 70 hours of recording revealed that men frequently discussed relationship problems and sexual issues with their friends. In contrast, they never mentioned football, and they rarely talked about women.

Louis van Gaal took responsibility for Manchester United ending the match with only 10 players. This happened because he had used all his substitutes before Michael Carrick was taken off as a precaution due to a tight calf. Van Gaal admitted, “It was my mistake to give too many minutes to my substitutes. That wasn’t wise.” He added that some players didn’t realize the team was down to 10 men because the crowd was shouting, making it hard to communicate with them. The text also notes that Van Gaal celebrated the win with Ander Herrera, Carrick walked off the field due to his injury, and Aguero scored a quick goal.

Three former England rugby players, Lewis Moody, Danny Grewcock, and Josh Lewsey, continued their charity trip to the North Pole even after their plane’s landing gear collapsed during takeoff. The players said they only felt a small bump. Before the takeoff, bad visibility at the temporary 800-meter runway next to the Russian-run Camp Barneo had caused them to cancel their landing.

Alan Stubbs praised his Hibernian players for their courage after they beat their rivals, Hearts, 2-0 at Easter Road. This victory stopped Hearts from celebrating a title win.

The win kept Hibernian in second place in the Championship. It was their second win in a row, which helped build confidence after they had lost three games in a row. This success also prepares the team for their Scottish Cup semi-final match against Falkirk on Saturday.

Stubbs noted that his team had played well but failed to beat Hearts in three previous games this season. He said his players proved they had the courage to win during the important final part of the season.
